items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 46:1
items.html: The MAN and the coarseness with which the upper light unites are called filling, and as long as they have not yet entered the secret of the union, they are considered a filling without the simple. See above, in Answer 45. (Item 32).
